name: R3 Medium Density Residential
source: SMMC 9.08.030 Table and standards; City Housing Element 2021-2029 Appendix E Figure E-2
verified: 2026-09-23 40 ft height, 35 ft daylight plane, upper-story front stepback and side stepback from 9.08.030 excerpts; setbacks, coverage and density from the City Housing Element table
notes: Front setback: 20 ft (or per Official Districting Map).
Side setbacks: parcels 50 ft or wider: 8 ft; narrower parcels: 16% of parcel width, min 4 ft.
Height: 3 stories / 40 ft (100% affordable: no story limit / 40 ft).
Parcel coverage: ground floor 50%; upper stories 90% of the allowable ground-floor coverage (upper-story figure not modeled).
Daylight plane: above 35 ft nothing may cross a plane starting 35 ft above the front setback line and rising at 45 degrees toward the rear.
Upper-story front stepback: covered portions above the 2nd story set back an average of 10 ft from the 2nd-floor front facade. Modeled as a flat 10 ft on stories 3+.
Upper-story side stepback: an additional 2 ft average at each story. Modeled as a flat 2 ft on stories 2+.
Edges abutting an R1 district: 10 ft interior side setback, 20 ft rear setback (flag the edge as 'adjacent low density').
Density: 1 unit per 1,500 sf of parcel or 5 units, whichever is less (Tier 1).
